I see. So I guess you weren't all that thrilled when I said I couldn't ignore a lady being harassed, huh? Maybe it sounded like I was looking down on you.
Yup, you get it. Still, I'm glad you did what you did.

This Nagasu Taxi driver is apparently taking on the Devil Killers.
I think his name's Suzuki-san, too...
(She's onto me!)

...You know, I just remembered I have some urgent business. Don't worry about that drink. I have to go.
I'll pay you back some other time, okay?

When men go out to eat, it's mostly about making sure we're all well fed, you know? We save the talking for when we go out drinking.

I'd usually go out alone. I mean, I met with plenty of clients for work dinners, but I also really valued my private time, too.
That makes sense, I guess. There are folks who'll come to the club 'cause they wanna be all by their lonesome.
